outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs only; no plot of averaged data is present, so this check does not apply.
The JC-1 and anti-HMGB1 bar graphs show mean values with error bars (n=20) but do not overlay the individual data points behind the averages.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot, so this check does not apply.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar graphs show mean values with error bars and sample sizes (n) but do not display the underlying individual data points.
The FACS panels are histograms/distribution plots of raw cell counts vs. TMRM intensity, not averaged summary statistics, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
